title: Jamaican Jerk Belly
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-inspired dish featuring belly meat, marinated in a blend of aromatic spices. This recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters looking to try something new.
instructions: Rinse the belly meat and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a blender or food processor, combine khus leaves, fermented soy sauce, adventurous hot sauce, brown sugar, black pepper, kosher salt, and allspice. Blend until smooth.
Place the belly meat in a large ziplock bag or a shallow dish. Pour the marinade over the meat, turning to coat evenly. Seal the bag or cover the dish with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight, flipping the meat halfway through.
Remove the meat from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Place the meat on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes per pound, or until the meat reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Let the meat rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
